packageRules.description: One grouped pull request a week for development dependencies.

Development dependency patches are grouped weekly and still merged by a human. Automerge was on here and contradicted the rule that checks never merge anything by themselves; a build tool can change shipped output.
Never automerge a runtime dependency, a major bump or a GitHub Action.
Actions are pinned to a commit hash on purpose. Renovate keeps the hash current and the comment beside it accurate; a human merges it.
TypeScript and Node move on the quarterly cadence plan section 4 sets, not whenever a release lands.
